title: Cheapest item that is in stock
description: Bug report for a shop helper that returns the name of the cheapest item that can be bought right now. Two symptoms: an item with stock 0 is sometimes returned, and when two available items have the same price the later one is returned instead of the earlier one. Fix the program. The complete rule is: only items with stock greater than 0 count; the answer is the name of the one with the lowest price; on equal prices the item that comes first in the list wins; if no item is available the result is none.
notes: Two bugs: availability test is stock >= 0 (should be > 0) and the replacement test is <= (should be <, first wins ties).
